clue.text: In poor condition morning after run, explorer's lost weight

indicators.note: morning comes after run, so its letters follow in the answer

parts.note: R is the cricket scoring abbreviation for a run
AM stands for ante meridiem, the morning

indicators.note: the explorer has lost something, so those letters are dropped from his name

parts.note: Ernest Shackleton was the Antarctic explorer
a ton is a unit of weight

explanation.surface: A worn-out expedition member, having run a morning race, has lost weight.
explanation.definitionFit: Ramshackle buildings are rickety and tumbledown, a synonym for being in a bad state.

clue.text: Needing lift, look for dance

indicators.note: in a down clue, lifting the word raises it so it reads from bottom to top

parts.note: to leer is to look slyly or lecherously

explanation.surface: Someone needs a lift and goes looking for a dance partner.
explanation.definitionFit: A reel is a lively Scottish folk dance.

clue.text: Appearance of middle of Amiens

indicators.note: the inner letters of the French city name, without its first and last, are taken

explanation.surface: A description of how the centre of the French city of Amiens looks.
explanation.definitionFit: Mien is a literary word for a person's bearing or look.

clue.text: Attitude, as you say, supported by a quiet father perhaps — he should succeed

indicators.note: in a down clue, the first part sits on top of what supports it
what you say is spoken, so the word is a sound-alike

parts.note: an air is a manner or attitude
p is piano, the musical direction for quiet
a father is an example of a parent

explanation.surface: A man's manner, backed by his discreet dad, marks him out as next in line.
explanation.definitionFit: The heir apparent is the person certain to inherit a title or throne, the one who will follow.

clue.text: In US stop complaining after notice is taken initially

indicators.note: the opening letters of the five words that follow are read together

explanation.surface: An American telling someone to quit griping once a warning has been given.
explanation.definitionFit: Can it is American slang ordering someone to be quiet or stop.

clue.text: See group surrounding judge — become disillusioned

parts.note: lo is an old word meaning look or see

indicators.note: the group word is placed around the judge word

parts.note: a set is a group
to hear a case is to judge it

explanation.surface: Watching a crowd close in on a judge would make anyone despair.
explanation.definitionFit: To lose heart is to become discouraged and lose one's enthusiasm.

clue.text: Closed second building

parts.note: a hut is a simple building

explanation.surface: A notice that a second building is not open.
explanation.definitionFit: Shut is a plain synonym of not open.

clue.text: Crustacean her guy's served up — grumble follows

indicators.note: the grumble word comes after the rest

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: in a down clue, served up means turned to read upwards

parts.note: Tim is a man's name, a guy
to crab is to complain

explanation.surface: Her man brings out a shellfish dish and then moans about it.
explanation.definitionFit: The hermit crab is a crustacean that lives in borrowed shells.

clue.text: Considerate but ultimately stringent if you fail

parts.note: though can mean but, as in 'odd, though true'

indicators.note: the final letters of the four words after it are read in turn

explanation.surface: A teacher who is kind, yet strict if you fail.
explanation.definitionFit: A thoughtful person shows consideration for others.

clue.text: Plastered wine set? Yes, I saw what happened

indicators.note: plastered means drunk, so these letters are reeling into a new order

explanation.surface: A drunk at a wine-tasting set insists they saw it all.
explanation.definitionFit: A witness at the scene could say these words, describing someone who personally watched the event.

clue.text: Group turn it on regularly

indicators.note: every other letter of the phrase, starting from the first, is picked

explanation.surface: An instruction to a band to switch on the power at intervals.
explanation.definitionFit: A trio is a group of three, especially musicians.

clue.text: Doctor in ban call had means to restrict movement

indicators.note: to doctor is to tamper with, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A medic subject to a ban on calls was kept from moving about.
explanation.definitionFit: A ball and chain is a heavy weight shackled to a prisoner's leg to stop escape.

clue.text: Hale — if a thing works? This?

definitions.text: Hale — if a thing works? This?

indicators.note: works suggests the letters being worked into a fresh arrangement

explanation.surface: Someone is cured, and the question is whether some remedy did it; this is it.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is the definition: a cure by faith leaves you hale if the thing works.
explanation.definitionFit: Faith healing claims to restore health through prayer or belief, so the patient becomes hale.

clue.text: Worthless people's scorn led us astray

indicators.note: going astray means wandering off course, so these letters are mixed up

explanation.surface: Good-for-nothings complain that contempt misled them.
explanation.definitionFit: Scoundrels are rogues and villains, people of no moral worth.

clue.text: Getting measure of adolescent I met recently?

indicators.note: the letters are taken from within the run of words that follow

explanation.surface: Sizing up a teenager I was recently introduced to.
explanation.definitionFit: A centimetre is a metric unit of length, a measure.

clue.text: Queen at beginning criticises stars seen with glib artist

indicators.note: only the opening letter of the next word is used

parts.note: Leo is a constellation, a group of stars
pat means slick or glib
RA is a Royal Academician, an artist

explanation.surface: A queen pans the stars appearing alongside a smooth-talking painter.
explanation.definitionFit: Cleopatra was the last queen of Ptolemaic Egypt.

clue.text: Man from North African city supplying fruit

definitions.meaning: a small loose-skinned citrus like a mandarin

explanation.surface: A Moroccan citizen is selling citrus.
explanation.definitionFit: The fruit takes its name from the port of Tangier, whose natives share the name.

clue.text: Allowed tenfold reduction in restriction at centre?

indicators.note: the Roman numeral for a thousand becomes the one for a hundred, a tenth of it
the change happens at the middle letter of the word

parts.note: a limit is a restriction

explanation.surface: A permitted cut of ninety per cent in central controls.
explanation.walkthrough: M is the Roman numeral 1000 and C is 100, so dividing by ten swaps one for the other.
explanation.definitionFit: Licit is a formal word meaning lawful or permitted.

clue.text: Complete, say

definitions.meaning: total, absolute, as in sheer nonsense

explanation.surface: Finish, and speak up.
explanation.definitionFit: As an adjective it means absolute; as a verb it means to speak aloud.

clue.text: Politician using web — some expression of surprise at university

indicators.note: the university letter is placed at the end

parts.note: a net is a web or mesh
any can mean some, as in 'have you any?'
ah is an exclamation of surprise

explanation.surface: An academic politician uses the internet and gets a surprised reaction on campus.
explanation.definitionFit: Benjamin Netanyahu is an Israeli prime minister, a politician.

clue.text: Inevitable consequences — sad end? Come off it!

indicators.note: sad suggests something in a sorry state, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone protests the gloomy ending of a story as unbelievable.
explanation.definitionFit: The domino effect is a chain reaction where one event inevitably triggers the next.

clue.text: Accommodation units, dull, small

parts.note: flat means dull or lifeless
S is the abbreviation for small, as on clothing labels

explanation.surface: Estate agent's description of apartments as drab and cramped.
explanation.definitionFit: Flats are apartments, self-contained units of housing.

clue.text: Fool flier

explanation.surface: Trick, bird.
explanation.definitionFit: To gull is to trick; a gull is a seabird.

clue.text: Extremely open and largely just

indicators.note: the extreme letters, first and last, of each of the two words are taken

explanation.surface: A description of something wide open and fair for the most part.
explanation.definitionFit: Just and only are synonyms, as in 'just a minute'.

clue.text: Takes in achievements, scratching head

indicators.note: the first letter of the word is scratched out

parts.note: feats are achievements

explanation.surface: Someone absorbs accomplishments while puzzling over them.
explanation.definitionFit: To take in food is to consume it, a synonym phrase.

clue.text: Central American seeing his leaders run again unexpectedly

indicators.note: the pooled letters are rearranged in a surprise order
his refers back to the definition words, whose leading letters are taken

explanation.surface: A man from Central America sees his party leaders stand for office again.
explanation.walkthrough: 'his leaders' points back to the definition words, giving CA; 'unexpectedly' scrambles CA with RUN AGAIN.
explanation.definitionFit: Nicaragua is a country in Central America, so a citizen is a Central American.

clue.text: Difficult situation political moderates recalled

indicators.note: called back, so the word runs backwards

parts.note: Wets were the moderate Conservatives who opposed Thatcher's hardline policies

explanation.surface: Centrist MPs are summoned back to deal with a crisis.
explanation.definitionFit: To be in a stew is an idiom for a state of agitation or trouble.

clue.text: By sound of it, notices working partner at certain times only

indicators.note: the word for notices is replaced by one that is said the same way

parts.note: sees means notices
on means operating or working
an ally is a partner

explanation.surface: Someone spots a colleague who only turns up now and then.
explanation.definitionFit: Something done seasonally happens only during particular seasons of the year.
